item.text: The observer path is narrow enough to replace cleanly. I’m wiring the event bus into `SimulationContext` so it becomes another shared domain service, then I’ll switch the view from `SimulationObserver` to event subscription with state carried on the emitted events.

I found one behavioral problem in the existing run loop while doing this: `simulate(int)` never actually stopped after the requested step count if the simulation stayed viable. I’m fixing that as part of the event refactor because otherwise `SimulationStopped` would be inconsistent and the long-run button would keep running indefinitely.

item.text:
Introduced an event bus around [`EventService`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/EventService.java>) and moved simulator notifications onto explicit domain events: [`SimulationStarted`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationStarted.java>), [`StepAdvanced`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/StepAdvanced.java>), [`SimulationReset`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationReset.java>), and [`SimulationStopped`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationStopped.java>). The service is now part of [`SimulationContext`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationContext.java>), so subscriptions happen through shared context rather than directly on `Simulator`.

[`Simulator.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java>) no longer keeps observer lists or calls UI callbacks. It captures state, emits domain events through `EventService`, and exposes the context for wiring. [`SimulatorView.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulatorView.java>) now implements [`SimulationEventListener`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationEventListener.java>) and renders from events, with UI updates dispatched onto the Swing event thread. [`Main.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Main.java>) now subscribes the view via `sim.getSimulationContext().getEventService().subscribe(view)` instead of `sim.addObserver(...)`.

I also removed the obsolete [`SimulationObserver.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationObserver.java>) and fixed the simulation loop so `simulate(int)` actually stops after the requested number of steps instead of repeating indefinitely while the state remains viable.

Verification: `javac *.java` passed.
